title: DoupConfig
description: Configuration for the doup dependency updater bot.

pluginRef.description: A plugin package reference in wkg format: namespace:package@version.

pluginWithConfig.description: A single-key object: the plugin reference mapped to its plugin specific configuration.

platform.description: The platform that doup will operate against, submitting pull requests with it's dependency updates. Think github, gitlab, bitbucket, etc. ONE MUST BE GIVEN.

ecosystems.description: The ecosystems of dependencies that doup will work to keep up to date. Think npm, nuget, go modules, rust crates, etc. AT LEAST ONE MUST BE GIVEN.
